While this was a team project, I worked on the backend and the database as well as the project architecture (technologies used, multi-module setup for client, server, common and their dependencies).

Since I was already familiar with the backend, database and distributed concepts, the project did not take very long to plan nor implement. Took me I think 3 days total to finish the entire thing. The development process was accelerated using coding agents for debugging and repetitive code. I reviewed every line of code and manually tweaked any weird AI fixes to comply with our chosen patterns.
